intro: The city rewards visitors with a compact centre, excellent museums, and lively riverside districts. Pick how long you have and what you enjoy most.
tour_note: Check the tour page for which entry tickets are included.

notes: Rheinbahn operates U-Bahn, trams, and buses; single ticket €3.80, 24-hour pass €7.60 (2026).
Validate tickets before boarding; fines €60 for unstamped tickets.
Ride apps Uber, Bolt, and Free Now work in Düsseldorf.
Driving: city centre is an environmental zone; cars need a pollution sticker.
Walking is easy in the compact centre; bike hire from ~€9/day.
No ferry across the Rhine; use bridges for crossing.

rheinturm.name: Rheinturm
rheinturm.price_text: Observation deck ticket; check current price on the day
rheinturm.hours: Daily, roughly 11:00–24:00; check on the day
rheinturm.tip: Go up near sunset for views over the Rhine and MedienHafen. The bar upstairs needs no deck ticket.

altstadt.name: Altstadt (Old Town)
altstadt.hours: Always open; bars busiest in the evening
altstadt.tip: This is the 'longest bar in the world' — wander the lanes early evening and pick a brewery by eye.

koenigsallee.name: Königsallee
koenigsallee.tip: Walk the canal side for the view, then cross to the shops. Most stores close on Sunday.

thefox.name: The Fox
thefox.price_text: Check current menu prices on the day
thefox.hours: Check on the day; often evening-focused
thefox.tip: Book ahead for dinner and confirm opening days before you go.

carlsplatz_market.name: Carlsplatz food market
carlsplatz_market.price_text: Free to enter; pay per stall
carlsplatz_market.hours: Mon–Fri roughly 08:00–18:00, Sat until about 16:00; closed Sunday
carlsplatz_market.tip: Come hungry at lunch for fresh bread, cheese and local snacks. Bring cash for small stalls.

medienhafen_walk.name: MedienHafen architecture walk
medienhafen_walk.tip: See the Gehry buildings and the Rhine promenade on foot; combine with the Rheinturm.

rhine_promenade.name: Rhine promenade (Rheinuferpromenade)
rhine_promenade.tip: Walk between Altstadt and MedienHafen along the water; busy and lively on warm evenings.

oberkassel_walk.name: Oberkassel neighbourhood walk
oberkassel_walk.tip: Cross the Rhine bridge for quieter streets, cafés and river views back to the skyline.

rhine_cruise.name: Rhine sightseeing cruise
rhine_cruise.price_text: Short cruises roughly EUR 10–20; check on the day
rhine_cruise.hours: Seasonal; departures mostly daytime, check on the day
rhine_cruise.tip: Short harbour cruises leave from near the Altstadt. Confirm departure times and weather before buying.

kunstpalette.name: Kunstpalast museum
kunstpalette.price_text: Admission fee; check current price on the day
kunstpalette.hours: Closed Monday; check on the day
kunstpalette.tip: Good rainy-day stop for art and photography; check the current exhibition first.

schlossturm.name: Schlossturm (ship museum)
schlossturm.price_text: Small admission fee; check on the day
schlossturm.hours: Check on the day; often closed Monday
schlossturm.tip: Small maritime museum in a tower by the river — quick visit, good with kids.

hofgarten.name: Hofgarten park
hofgarten.tip: Green escape next to Königsallee; good for a picnic or a shaded break.

altbier_tasting.name: Altbier brewery tasting
altbier_tasting.price_text: Pay per glass; check on the day
altbier_tasting.hours: Breweries open daytime into evening; check on the day
altbier_tasting.tip: Try Altbier in a traditional Altstadt brewery. Servers keep refilling until you cover your glass.

stadtmitte_shopping.name: Stadtmitte shopping streets
stadtmitte_shopping.tip: Beyond Königsallee, the side streets have everyday shops and cafés. Most close Sunday.

rheinpark_viewpoint.name: Rhine bank viewpoint near Oberkassel bridge
rheinpark_viewpoint.tip: Best skyline photo spot across the river; go at dusk when lights come on.

medienhafen_food.name: MedienHafen cafés and riverside bars
medienhafen_food.price_text: Pay per item; check on the day
medienhafen_food.hours: Daytime into evening; check on the day
medienhafen_food.tip: Grab a coffee or drink after the architecture walk and watch the river traffic.

altstadt_nightlife.name: Altstadt bar streets
altstadt_nightlife.hours: Busiest from evening; late on weekends
altstadt_nightlife.tip: The lanes fill up after dark. Keep an eye on your belongings in crowds.

rhine_ferry.name: Rhine ferry crossing
rhine_ferry.price_text: Small fare; check on the day
rhine_ferry.tip: A cheap way to cross the river and see the banks from the water.

stadtmitte_cafe.name: Stadtmitte café stop
stadtmitte_cafe.price_text: Pay per item; check on the day
stadtmitte_cafe.hours: Mostly daytime; check on the day
stadtmitte_cafe.tip: Take a break between Königsallee and the Altstadt. Many places close by early evening.

stays.why: Sleep among the old-town bars and the Rhine promenade. Walk to most sights. Can be noisy at night.
Modern architecture and riverside walks. Quiet at night, a short tram or walk to the centre.
Central and well connected. Best for shopping on Königsallee and easy transit links.
Leafy left-bank neighbourhood with cafés and a Rhine view. Cross the bridge for the Altstadt.

food: Try Rheinish dishes: Himmel und Erde (black pudding with apple and potato), Sauerbraten and Reibekuchen (potato fritters).
Drink Altbier in the Altstadt brewpubs. It comes in small glasses and is refilled without asking; say when to stop.
Go to the Carlsplatz market for snacks, cheese and coffee. Check opening hours on the day.
Rheinish mustard and Printen gingerbread make easy gifts. Look in the Altstadt shops.
Book dinner ahead on weekends. Many kitchens close earlier on Sundays; check on the day.
more_time: Swap a city afternoon for Schloss Benrath: a palace and gardens south of town, reachable by tram or S-Bahn. Check opening days.
Take the train to Cologne for the cathedral and old town, roughly 25–35 minutes each way. Check times and fares on the day.
On a rainy day, swap a walk for the Kunstpalast or the Film Museum. Check current exhibitions and prices.
